about_the_game:
Developed by a solo developer, my goal was to create a game about a YouTuber who risks his life by exploring a haunted house to boost his channel's popularity.

Main character equipped with just a flashlight, camera, and nerves of steel, venture into its eerie, decaying halls of a house that belonged to old couple. The silence and unsettling sounds keep you on edge as you piece together the tragic and supernatural past of the house. What begins as routine content soon turns into a terrifying reality, blurring the line between myth and truth.

Find out what happened to the house and to old couple.

Can you survive the house’s dark history and escape to share your story, or will you become another lost soul in the The Dead House?

WASD for movement

"C" for Camera

CTRL for crouching

Special thanks to George Thompson for his dev services.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card

short_description: Play as an ambitious YouTuber known for exploring paranormal and creepypasta stories. Your latest video takes you to a hauntingly beautiful, abandoned mansion, rumored to hide dark secrets.
